about_the_game:
Edge Road is a school life action-adventure game.

An ordinary boy gains the power of an 'Edgelord' through an unexpected event.
With this special ability, the boy takes on various groups of bullies who ruin the lively school atmosphere, outlaw bikers on the road, and bank robbers who threaten the peace of the neighborhood. As he makes a name for himself, he gains additional allies who join him to bring justice together.

Experience this inspiring journey to become the most popular boy in town with 'Edgelord' powers!

Features

Ordinary weapons? No, I need something cooler!

To defend justice, you need a weapon. The 'Edgelord' doesn't fight with ordinary weapons; he has a unique set of gadgets that he uses to uphold justice in his own style!

- Exhilarating ' Electric mosquito swatter'
- Upbeat 'Electric guitar'
- Stylish 'Model gun' action



Action with style!

Every single one of Edgelord's actions is stylish, even when he's rolling on the ground!

- Unleash crazy action with unique weapons.



Working in many places

From schools to banks to high streets, we work on many different stages of justice.

- 5 locations Classroom / Downtown / Crossroads / Bank / Arcade Center
- 5 chapters. 30 stages in total.

Unique enemies

Take on bikers, bank robbers, and other unique enemies as you seek justice.

- Over 30 types of monsters



Friends with Benefits

'Edgelord' doesn't mean have no friends. Connect with your schoolmates to get to know them better, and let them give you the support you need!

- Partners come in 4 different professions Kendo Master / Archer / Maid / Tea Ceremony Master
- As you increase the likability of your partners, they will help you in battle.
- Depending on your partner's favorability, you'll experience different conversations.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 /8.1 /10 /11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 8100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 or AMD Radeon R9 270X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® 11 supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 /11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3500X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® 11 supported

short_description: 'Edge Road' is an action game that tells the story of an ordinary student who becomes the most famous and popular person in his school. Help students, become a local vigilante, and experience a school life worthy of an 'Edgelord'.
